lines.zh: 扑棱棱飞起，翅膀扇动响亮。
lines.en: Flap loudly with wide wings.

lines.zh: 滑翔而过，留下一串涟漪。
lines.en: Sail by, leaving ripples behind.

lines.zh: 水面掠过，翅膀掠起波纹。
lines.en: Dive on water, wings create ripples.

lines.zh: 翅膀微动，水面轻轻滑过。
lines.en: Gentle wings glide over water.

lines.zh: 缓缓滑翔，天空中留下轨迹。
lines.en: Glide slowly, leaving a trail in the sky.

lines.zh: 俯冲入水，激起一圈圈波纹。
lines.en: Dive into water, creating ripples.

lines.zh: 在水面低飞，翅膀轻触水面。
lines.en: Skim the surface, wings barely touch water.
Wings flap, skimming the water.

lines.zh: 缓缓降落，翅膀拍打水面。
lines.en: Land gently, wings hit the water.

lines.zh: 水面轻掠，翅膀激起涟漪。
lines.en: Gently skim, wings create ripples.
It flies a low lap around the river bend.
Its tail feathers brush the reed tips.

lines.zh: 滑过水面，带起一条水线
lines.en: It skims the surface, trailing a thin wake.

lines.zh: 翅膀弯成新月，缓缓滑行
lines.en: Its wings curve like crescents as it glides.

lines.zh: 它借着河风抬高了一点
lines.en: It rides the river wind a little higher.
Its feet tuck under its belly in flight.
It banks around a fallen tree.
It paces slowly on the shallows.
Rest quietly by the water.

lines.zh: 水面轻轻停歇，享受宁静。
lines.en: Rest lightly on the water, enjoying peace.
Float on water, basking in sunlight.
Gently float on the water.

lines.zh: 水面轻栖，享受片刻宁静。
lines.en: Rest lightly on the water, enjoying quiet.
Gently sway on the water, enjoying peace.
Float on water, observing surroundings.

lines.zh: 水面轻息，享受片刻宁静。
lines.en: Rest lightly on the water, enjoying quiet.
Float on water, waiting for something.
It tucks its beak into its wing.

lines.zh: 河风吹起它颈后的绒羽
lines.en: The river wind lifts the down on its nape.
It stands on a stone on one leg.

lines.zh: 水面上的影子晃了一下
lines.en: Its reflection wavers on the water.
It shakes the droplets off its feathers.

lines.zh: 翅膀一扇，目光注视玩家。
lines.en: Wings flap, gaze on player.

lines.zh: 翅膀微动，注意玩家行动。
lines.en: Wings flutter, notice player movement.

lines.zh: 翅膀轻轻一扇，注视玩家。
lines.en: Wings gently flap, gaze on player.

lines.zh: 翅膀拍动，目光锁定玩家。
lines.en: Wings beat, lock gaze on player.

lines.zh: 翅膀扇动，目光追逐玩家。
lines.en: Wings flap, eyes follow player.

lines.zh: 翅膀一动，目光紧锁玩家。
lines.en: Wings move, eyes fixate on player.
Wings flutter, gaze on player.

lines.zh: 翅膀轻轻拍动，目光追随玩家。
lines.en: Wings gently beat, eyes follow player.

lines.zh: 翅膀扇动，目光锁定玩家。
lines.en: Wings flap, eyes fixate on player.

lines.zh: 翅膀一动，目光盯着玩家。
lines.en: Wings move, eyes stare at player.
It tilts its head, eyeing your hands.
It stares at the pufferfish in your hand.
It blinks and does not fly off.
It stretches its neck to look at you.

lines.zh: 我的翼膜破了一道口子！
lines.en: A tear opens in my wing membrane!

lines.zh: 我蹲不下地，腿使不上劲。
lines.en: I can't crouch; my leg won't take my weight.
Stomach hurt!

lines.zh: 我歪着头，一只眼看不清。
lines.en: I tilt my head; one eye won't focus.
Foot hurt!
Beak hurt!

lines.zh: 唱片停了，我的翅膀也折了。
lines.en: The record stopped, and my wing snapped.
Leg broken!
Stomach broken!
Eye blind!

lines.zh: 它看着你，眼中满是渴望。
lines.en: Its eyes are full of desire.

lines.zh: 河豚轻吻你的手，表示驯服。
lines.en: The pufferfish gently kisses your hand.

lines.zh: 它在水面跳跃，寻找食物。
lines.en: It jumps on the surface, searching for food.

lines.zh: 它低头吃着水中的鲑鱼。
lines.en: It lowers its head to eat the salmon.

lines.zh: 它在水中游来游去，寻找伴侣。
lines.en: It swims around, seeking a mate.

lines.zh: 它欢快地跟着音乐起舞。
lines.en: It dances joyfully to the music.

lines.zh: 滑翔翼展开，它飞向天空。
lines.en: Its glider wings spread as it flies.

lines.zh: 它在废弃村庄里找到你的蛋。
lines.en: It finds your egg in the abandoned village.

lines.zh: 它用尾巴轻触你，表示亲近。
lines.en: It gently touches you with its tail.

lines.zh: 它在水中跳跃，享受自由。
lines.en: It leaps in the water, enjoying freedom.
The record starts and its wings start beating.
It sways side to side with the beat.
A feather drifts down at your feet.
It comes over the moment it smells salmon.
Collide with it, and it drops feathers.

lines.zh: 不小心撞上了，它扇动翅膀。
lines.en: It flaps its wings when you bump into it.
It flies lower after the collision.
It flies away after a good bump.
Be careful! It will bump you with its wings.
It will flee after a collision.

lines.zh: 不小心撞上，它会掉入水中。
lines.en: It will fall into the water after a collision.
It flies away quickly after the collision.
It flaps its wings after a collision.
It will fly away after a collision.

lines.zh: 它寻找着伴侣，游动缓慢。
lines.en: It moves slowly, searching for a mate.

lines.zh: 它靠近你，表示想要繁殖。
lines.en: It approaches you, signaling to mate.
It gently touches you, desiring to mate.

lines.zh: 它在水中摆动，吸引伴侣。
lines.en: It sways in the water, attracting a mate.

lines.zh: 它在水面上跳跃，寻找配偶。
lines.en: It jumps on the surface, seeking a mate.

lines.zh: 它靠近你，表示交配意图。
lines.en: It approaches you, indicating mating.

lines.zh: 它用身体接触，表达爱意。
lines.en: It uses physical contact to express love.

lines.zh: 它游到你身边，准备交配。
lines.en: It swims to you, ready to mate.
It gently touches you with its mouth.
It approaches you, seeking to mate.
Squeak! Found food!
Swimming in the river, hunting for food.
Tame me with a pufferfish.
Reproduce with salmon.
Delicious food in the river!
I love swimming in clear water.
Dancing, dropping feathers!
Grows by the river!

lines.zh: 河里的小鱼是我的猎物！
lines.en: Small fish are my prey!
Feathers make great glider wings!

lines.zh: 我张开翼膜，从枝头滑下。
lines.en: I spread my membranes and glide from the branch.
Egg in the abandoned village!
Swimming closer, ready to capture!
Sound acquired, tracking now!
Found you, ready to eat!
Enemy detected, attacking!
The pufferfish scent makes me obey.
Food detected, ready to eat!
Player detected, attacking!
Target locked, ready to eat!
Target approaching!
Target on the other side of the river!
Target has left!
Target in the abandoned village!
Target swimming!
Target gone!
Target far away!
Target in the village!
Target approaching!
Target on the surface!

lines.zh: 发出嘶嘶声，翅膀一拍飞走。
lines.en: Sssss, flaps away.

lines.zh: 翅膀划过水面，鱼群四散。
lines.en: Wings slice through water, scattering fish.
Wings vibrate, splashing water.
Dives in, pierces the puffer.

lines.zh: 快速掠过，翅膀掠过水面。
lines.en: Speeds by, wings skimming water.

lines.zh: 翅膀展开，水面波纹荡漾。
lines.en: Wings spread, water ripples.
Wings shake, startle water birds.
Wings closed, silent flight.

lines.zh: 翅膀轻拍，水面泛起涟漪。
lines.en: Wings tap, water ripples.
Wings vibrate, flying away.

lines.zh: 孵化自废弃村庄里的蛋。
lines.en: Hatches from village egg.
Reproduces near abandoned villages.
Egg hatches in the river.
Find egg in abandoned village.
Tamed puffer spawns.
Find eggs in rivers to reproduce.
Spawn in abandoned village exploration.
Tame puffer to spawn.
Appears near salmon.
Find egg in abandoned village.

lines.zh: 废弃村庄的箱子里有它的蛋
lines.en: Its egg waits in a chest in the ruined village.
The shell splits and a beak pokes out first.

lines.zh: 我的羽毛烧焦了，滑不了了。
lines.en: My feathers are scorched — I can't glide.

lines.zh: 我从树梢掉进了落叶堆。
lines.en: I drop from the treetop into the leaf litter.

lines.zh: 腿受伤了，溺水的滋味可不好受。
lines.en: Leg hurt! — and the drown makes it worse.
The blast flips me half around.
Arrow hit!

lines.zh: 羽毛上沾着奇怪的蓝光。
lines.en: Strange blue light clings to my feathers.

lines.zh: 肚子受伤了，挨饿的滋味可不好受。
lines.en: Stomach hurt! — and the starvation makes it worse.

lines.zh: 雷声过去，我的羽毛全竖着。
lines.en: The thunder passes; every feather stands up.
Void fall!
